description: A stated recurring or automation intent (workflow, every day, track) must lead to a built flow, not a one-off code run or web search.
userTurns: I want a workflow that fetches the release notes of our dependencies every Monday and posts them to Slack.

judge.rubric: The user asked for a workflow with a recurring cadence. PASS if the assistant commits to building an automation: researching pieces, asking for a needed connection, or calling the build tools. FAIL if it answers with a one-off lookup, a web search summary or a code run, or only shows a showcase of what it can do without building.
